name: Vampire - Spider Climb - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a feature

results.text: A sudden gust of wind betrays him, sending the vampire tumbling back to earth with an unnatural, boneless thud.
For the first time in centuries, gravity claims victory as his grip falters on the unforgiving stone surface.
A mocking cackle echoes through the chamber as the vampire's descent is abruptly halted by an unseen force.
The ceiling resists him this night, his claws finding no purchase against the slick, unyielding surface.
With a snarl of frustration, the undead lord slumps to the ground, his usual dominance over height momentarily shattered.
